Selected Clients & Credits

Work that travels — from Chennai studios to a Dublin premiere.

Naveen is Senior Colourist at Figureout Post and a filmmaker in his own right. His grade has shaped national brand campaigns, chart-facing music videos and an Irish feature — always with restraint, skin-tone honesty and a signature warmth that never shouts.

This is the luxury concept: no noise, no hard sell. Just large images, generous space and the confidence to let the work speak — the language premium agencies and directors already understand.

About

NAV —
The eye behind
the feeling.

Naveen — known as NAV — is a filmmaker and Senior Colourist at Figureout Post. He also teaches at Master Color Academy, but this portfolio is for the other side of his practice: the quiet, premium grading work for people who shoot with intention.

Working remotely with calibrated monitoring, he collaborates across India and internationally — directors send a vision, he returns a feeling. Live sessions, versioned deliveries, and a process built on trust.
